SearchIndex.title: Search Index
SearchIndex.description: Indexed content from books and supplications for cloud search.

bookId.description: Unique ID of the book or item.

bookTitle.description: Title of the book or item.

url.description: URL to the source PDF or item.

category.description: Category of the item (e.g., كتب, أدعية).

FatwaQuestion.title: Fatwa Question
FatwaQuestion.description: Questions submitted by users for religious guidance.

userId.description: ID of the user who submitted the question.

telegramMessageId.description: ID of the message in Telegram.

name.description: Display name of the TV channel.

logoUrl.description: HTTP URL directing to the channel logo image.

streamUrl.description: HLS streaming URL (.m3u8) for the channel.

TvProgram.title: TV Program
TvProgram.description: Program schedule details for a specific time on a TV channel.

channelId.description: Unique ID of the television channel.

title.description: Title of the TV program or show.

startTime.description: Start time of the program, styled as 'HH:MM' (e.g., '13:45') or standard full ISO string.

endTime.description: End time of the program, styled as 'HH:MM' (e.g., '14:30') or standard full ISO string.

day.description: Optional day of week (e.g., 'all', 'monday') or date string.

Book.title: Book
Book.description: A book schema for library items.

title.description: The title of the question or shubha.

ZowarPost.title: Zowar Post
ZowarPost.description: Hosting posts registered by users to host visitors.

city.description: City or district of the hosting place.

bookings.description: List of user UIDs who booked.

search_indexes/{indexId}.description: Collection of indexed content for searching across library and supplications.

fatwa_questions/{questionId}.description: Collection of religious questions submitted by users.

tv_channels/{channelId}.description: Collection of live streaming television channels.

tv_programs/{programId}.description: Collection of programs or show schedules linked to specific TV channels.

books/{bookId}.description: Collection of books in the library.

zowar_posts/{postId}.description: Collection of hosting posts submitted by users.
